code='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    for r in range(h):
        if len(set(grid[r])) == 1 and grid[r][0] != 0 and r == h // 2:
            a, b = grid[:r], grid[r + 1:]
            if len(a) == len(b):
                return [[2 if x != 0 and y != 0 else 0 for x, y in zip(row_a, row_b)] for row_a, row_b in zip(a, b)]
    for c in range(w):
        vals = [grid[r][c] for r in range(h)]
        if len(set(vals)) == 1 and vals[0] != 0 and c == w // 2:
            a, b = [row[:c] for row in grid], [row[c + 1:] for row in grid]
            if all(len(x) == len(y) for x, y in zip(a, b)):
                return [[2 if x != 0 and y != 0 else 0 for x, y in zip(row_a, row_b)] for row_a, row_b in zip(a, b)]
    raise ValueError('divider not found')
'''
